build.name: Titan Interaction Engine v10.3.2 Phase 6.2 Installer/Admin Fix
build.status: standalone/source release candidate; connected Titan host certification unverified
build.strategy: Preserve the mature interaction runtime and Phase 6.1 settings while fixing install-time clean boot for unconfigured security secrets and adding resilient Super Admin navigation. company_id tenancy and provider ownership remain unchanged.

phase6_architecture: company_id remains the canonical platform company boundary.
CapabilityRouter dispatches to independent CRM, Builder, Chatbot, Connect, Mobile and TitanAI providers.
Unknown, unbound or unavailable capabilities fail closed.
Authority and approval decisions occur before provider execution.
CRM/Builder/Chatbot/Connect/Mobile/TitanAI persistence remains outside Interaction Engine ownership.
Field/Home Services onboarding compiles provider-specific actions with explicit dependencies and activation last.
Titan Hub, Titan Go, Titan Command and Titan Onboarding consume one shared wizard/session protocol.
LocalBrain v2 and offline wizard/outbox support remain part of Interaction Engine.

provider_status.crm: Capability provider/catalogue implemented; current company-scoped CRM execution gateway not verified in this package and therefore fails closed.
provider_status.builder: Provider implemented; current adapter supports only verified preview/publish/rollback contracts when present.
provider_status.chatbot: Provider implemented; provisioning gateway remains unavailable until a verified public company-scoped gateway is bound.
provider_status.connect: Provider implemented; current adapter supports verified messaging sends where the published gateway is compatible; secure connection/OAuth setup remains provider-owned.
provider_status.mobile: Provider/catalogue implemented; supplied MobileCapabilityRegistry is global rather than company-scoped, so no automatic readiness adapter is enabled. Live mobile capabilities remain unavailable until a verified company-scoped Mobile gateway is bound.
provider_status.titan_ai: Provider implemented; configuration gateway remains unavailable until a verified public company-scoped gateway is bound.

remaining_gates: Install into the current MagicAI/Titan Laravel host and run provider/container/route/migration tests.
Verify current company-scoped CRM provisioning/action gateway and bind only its published capabilities.
Verify current Builder, Chatbot, Connect, Mobile and TitanAI gateway contracts in the integrated host.
Run end-to-end Apex Plumbing onboarding with real provider confirmations.
Run multi-company and four-PWA browser/device tests against live persistence and queues.
historical_provenance: SOURCE-PROVENANCE.json and PHASE*_BUILD_REPORT.md files are retained as source-history evidence and are not descriptions of the current runtime architecture.
